source_refs.note: Exercise 10.3, Question 2: book pages 194-195 (PDF 199-200); no answer key entry (proofs); (v) holds only where its right side is positive, boxed; checked with sympy and the solution book (PDF 936-951).

blocks.explanation:
Left side par cot aur tan ka farq hai, right side par double angle ka cot. Matlab angle dugna karna hai.
Plan: dono ko sin aur cos mein likh kar ek denominator banana; phir upar \(\cos 2\alpha\) aur neeche \(\frac{1}{2}\sin 2\alpha\) pehchanna.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: L.H.S. \(= \cot\alpha - \tan\alpha\).
Humein prove karna hai: L.H.S. \(= 2\cot 2\alpha\).
Tareeqa: Sab kuch sin aur cos mein; phir \(\cos 2\alpha = \cos^2\alpha - \sin^2\alpha\) aur \(\sin 2\alpha = 2\sin\alpha\cos\alpha\). Identity prove karne ka sab se mehfooz tareeqa yahi hai ke mushkil side (aksar left) ko sin/cos mein le aayein.

Ek denominator banayein
\[\text{L.H.S.} = \dfrac{\cos\alpha}{\sin\alpha} - \dfrac{\sin\alpha}{\cos\alpha}\]
\[= \dfrac{\cos^2\alpha - \sin^2\alpha}{\sin\alpha\cos\alpha}\]
Kyun: \(\cot\alpha = \frac{\cos\alpha}{\sin\alpha}\), \(\tan\alpha = \frac{\sin\alpha}{\cos\alpha}\). Dono fractions ka common denominator \(\sin\alpha\cos\alpha\) hai; cross multiply se upar \(\cos^2\alpha - \sin^2\alpha\).

Double angle formulas lagayein
\[= \dfrac{\cos 2\alpha}{\tfrac{1}{2}\sin 2\alpha}\]
\[= \dfrac{2\cos 2\alpha}{\sin 2\alpha} = 2\cot 2\alpha\]
Kyun: Upar \(\cos^2\alpha - \sin^2\alpha\) bilkul \(\cos 2\alpha\) hai. Neeche \(\sin 2\alpha = 2\sin\alpha\cos\alpha\) hai, is liye \(\sin\alpha\cos\alpha\) us ka aadha. Aadhe se divide karna 2 se multiply karna hai. \(\frac{\cos 2\alpha}{\sin 2\alpha} = \cot 2\alpha\).
Dhyan dein: 2 ka factor kahan se aaya, yeh exam mein zaroor likhein.

blocks.explanation:
Left side par double angles hain, right side par single angle. Is liye double angles ko kholna hai.
Plan: \(\sin 2\alpha\) ko kholna aur \(1 + \cos 2\alpha\) ko \(2\cos^2\alpha\) likhna; phir cancel.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: L.H.S. \(= \frac{\sin 2\alpha}{1 + \cos 2\alpha}\).
Humein prove karna hai: L.H.S. \(= \tan\alpha\).
Tareeqa: \(\sin 2\alpha = 2\sin\alpha\cos\alpha\) aur \(1 + \cos 2\alpha = 2\cos^2\alpha\), jo \(\cos 2\alpha = 2\cos^2\alpha - 1\) se aata hai.

Dono double angles kholein
\[\text{L.H.S.} = \dfrac{2\sin\alpha\cos\alpha}{2\cos^2\alpha}\]
Kyun: \(\cos 2\alpha\) ki teen shakalon mein se \(2\cos^2\alpha - 1\) chuni, kyunke denominator mein pehle se \(+1\) hai; dono 1 cancel ho jate hain aur sirf \(2\cos^2\alpha\) bachta hai. Sahi shakal chunna hi aadha kaam hai.

Cancel karein
\[= \dfrac{\sin\alpha}{\cos\alpha} = \tan\alpha\]
Kyun: Upar neeche 2 aur ek \(\cos\alpha\) common hai; cancel karne se \(\frac{\sin\alpha}{\cos\alpha}\) bacha, jo \(\tan\alpha\) hai.

blocks.explanation:
Right side par aadha angle \(\frac{\alpha}{2}\) hai. Is ka ishara yeh hai ke \(\alpha\) ko \(\frac{\alpha}{2}\) ka double samjhein.
Plan: \(1 - \cos\alpha\) aur \(\sin\alpha\) dono ko \(\frac{\alpha}{2}\) mein likhna, phir cancel.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: L.H.S. \(= \frac{1 - \cos\alpha}{\sin\alpha}\).
Humein prove karna hai: L.H.S. \(= \tan\frac{\alpha}{2}\).
Tareeqa: Double angle formulas, angle \(\frac{\alpha}{2}\) ke saath: \(\cos\alpha = 1 - 2\sin^2\frac{\alpha}{2}\) aur \(\sin\alpha = 2\sin\frac{\alpha}{2}\cos\frac{\alpha}{2}\). Jo formula \(2\theta\) aur \(\theta\) ke liye hai, wohi \(\alpha\) aur \(\frac{\alpha}{2}\) ke liye bhi hai.

Sab kuch \(\frac{\alpha}{2}\) mein likhein
\[\text{L.H.S.} = \dfrac{2\sin^2\frac{\alpha}{2}}{2\sin\frac{\alpha}{2}\cos\frac{\alpha}{2}}\]
Kyun: \(\cos\alpha = 1 - 2\sin^2\frac{\alpha}{2}\) se \(1 - \cos\alpha = 2\sin^2\frac{\alpha}{2}\); is shakal mein 1 cancel ho jata hai, isi liye yeh chuni. Neeche \(\sin\alpha\) ka double angle formula.

Cancel karein
\[= \dfrac{\sin\frac{\alpha}{2}}{\cos\frac{\alpha}{2}} = \tan\dfrac{\alpha}{2}\]
Kyun: Upar neeche \(2\sin\frac{\alpha}{2}\) common tha. Bacha hua sin bata cos, yani tan.

blocks.explanation:
Right side par double angles (\(2\alpha\)) hain aur left side par single. Hamein left side mein \(\cos 2\alpha\) paida karna hai.
Plan: left side ko upar neeche \(\cos\alpha - \sin\alpha\) se multiply karna, taake neeche difference of squares ban kar \(\cos 2\alpha\) aa jaye.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: L.H.S. \(= \frac{\cos\alpha - \sin\alpha}{\cos\alpha + \sin\alpha}\).
Humein prove karna hai: L.H.S. \(= \sec 2\alpha - \tan 2\alpha\).
Tareeqa: \((\cos\alpha - \sin\alpha)^2 = 1 - \sin 2\alpha\) aur \((\cos\alpha - \sin\alpha)(\cos\alpha + \sin\alpha) = \cos 2\alpha\). Yeh wohi chaal hai jo surds ko rationalise karte waqt lagate hain.

Upar neeche \(\cos\alpha - \sin\alpha\) se multiply karein
\[\text{L.H.S.} = \dfrac{(\cos\alpha - \sin\alpha)^2}{\cos^2\alpha - \sin^2\alpha}\]
Kyun: Upar neeche ek hi cheez se multiply karne se value nahi badalti. Neeche \((a - b)(a + b) = a^2 - b^2\) ban gaya.

Upar aur neeche simplify karein
\[(\cos\alpha - \sin\alpha)^2 = 1 - 2\sin\alpha\cos\alpha\]
\[= 1 - \sin 2\alpha\]
\[\text{L.H.S.} = \dfrac{1 - \sin 2\alpha}{\cos 2\alpha}\]
Kyun: Square kholne se \(\cos^2\alpha + \sin^2\alpha - 2\sin\alpha\cos\alpha\) aaya; pehle do milkar 1, aur \(2\sin\alpha\cos\alpha = \sin 2\alpha\). Neeche \(\cos^2\alpha - \sin^2\alpha = \cos 2\alpha\).

Fraction ko do hisson mein torein
\[= \dfrac{1}{\cos 2\alpha} - \dfrac{\sin 2\alpha}{\cos 2\alpha}\]
\[= \sec 2\alpha - \tan 2\alpha\]
Kyun: Ek denominator wale fraction ko har term par alag divide kar sakte hain. \(\frac{1}{\cos} = \sec\) aur \(\frac{\sin}{\cos} = \tan\). Right side mil gaya.
Dhyan dein: ulta raasta (right side se shuru kar ke left tak) bhi bilkul sahi proof hai.

blocks.explanation:
Right side par \(\frac{\alpha}{2}\) hai, is liye \(1 + \sin\alpha\) aur \(1 - \sin\alpha\) ko \(\frac{\alpha}{2}\) ke poore squares (perfect squares) mein likhna hai.
Plan: 1 ko \(\sin^2\frac{\alpha}{2} + \cos^2\frac{\alpha}{2}\) likhna aur \(\sin\alpha = 2\sin\frac{\alpha}{2}\cos\frac{\alpha}{2}\); phir square root.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: L.H.S. \(= \sqrt{\frac{1 + \sin\alpha}{1 - \sin\alpha}}\).
Humein prove karna hai: L.H.S. \(= \frac{\sin\frac{\alpha}{2} + \cos\frac{\alpha}{2}}{\sin\frac{\alpha}{2} - \cos\frac{\alpha}{2}}\).
Tareeqa: Chhoti likhai ke liye \(s = \sin\frac{\alpha}{2}\), \(c = \cos\frac{\alpha}{2}\). Phir \(1 + \sin\alpha = (s + c)^2\) aur \(1 - \sin\alpha = (s - c)^2\). Square root ke andar squares hon to root aasani se khulta hai.

\(1 + \sin\alpha\) ko poora square banayein
\[1 + \sin\alpha = s^2 + c^2 + 2sc\]
\[= (s + c)^2\]
Kyun: \(\sin^2 + \cos^2 = 1\) kisi bhi angle ke liye, \(\frac{\alpha}{2}\) ke liye bhi. Aur \(2sc = 2\sin\frac{\alpha}{2}\cos\frac{\alpha}{2} = \sin\alpha\). Teeno terms milkar \((s + c)^2\) ka pattern \(a^2 + b^2 + 2ab\) banate hain.

\(1 - \sin\alpha\) ko poora square banayein
\[1 - \sin\alpha = s^2 + c^2 - 2sc\]
\[= (s - c)^2\]
Kyun: Wohi tareeqa, bas beech mein minus: \(a^2 + b^2 - 2ab = (a - b)^2\).

Square root lein
\[\text{L.H.S.} = \sqrt{\dfrac{(s + c)^2}{(s - c)^2}}\]
\[= \dfrac{s + c}{s - c}\]
Kyun: Square ka square root wohi quantity wapas deta hai, bashart-e-ke woh positive ho. Yahi kitab ka right side hai.
Dhyan dein: square root kabhi negative nahi hota. Agar \(\frac{s + c}{s - c}\) negative ho (jaise \(\alpha = 0\) par) to barabari toot jati hai; neeche wala box dekhein.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki shakal mein yeh identity sirf tab sahi hai jab right side positive ho, maslan \(\frac{\pi}{2} < \alpha < \frac{3\pi}{2}\). Acute \(\alpha\) ke liye yeh ghalat hai: \(\alpha = 0\) par left side 1 hai magar right side \(\frac{0 + 1}{0 - 1} = -1\). Asal mein left side \(\left|\frac{\sin\frac{\alpha}{2} + \cos\frac{\alpha}{2}}{\sin\frac{\alpha}{2} - \cos\frac{\alpha}{2}}\right|\) ke barabar hai; \(-\frac{\pi}{2} < \alpha < \frac{\pi}{2}\) ke liye sahi right side \(\frac{\cos\frac{\alpha}{2} + \sin\frac{\alpha}{2}}{\cos\frac{\alpha}{2} - \sin\frac{\alpha}{2}}\) hai. Exam mein upar wala proof likhein aur yeh shart ek line mein bata dein.

blocks.explanation:
Left side par reciprocal ratios hain (\(\operatorname{cosec}\), \(\sec\)) aur angles \(\theta\), \(2\theta\); right side par aadha angle.
Plan: pehle sab sin/cos mein, phir \(\frac{1 + \cos\theta}{\sin\theta}\) tak simplify, aur aakhir mein \(\frac{\theta}{2}\) wale formulas.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: L.H.S. \(= \frac{\operatorname{cosec}\theta + 2\operatorname{cosec} 2\theta}{\sec\theta}\).
Humein prove karna hai: L.H.S. \(= \cot\frac{\theta}{2}\).
Tareeqa: \(\operatorname{cosec} 2\theta = \frac{1}{\sin 2\theta} = \frac{1}{2\sin\theta\cos\theta}\). Phir \(1 + \cos\theta = 2\cos^2\frac{\theta}{2}\) aur \(\sin\theta = 2\sin\frac{\theta}{2}\cos\frac{\theta}{2}\).

Sin aur cos mein badlein
\[\text{L.H.S.} = \cos\theta\left[\dfrac{1}{\sin\theta} + \dfrac{2}{2\sin\theta\cos\theta}\right]\]
Kyun: \(\sec\theta\) se divide karna \(\cos\theta\) se multiply karne ke barabar hai, kyunke \(\sec\theta = \frac{1}{\cos\theta}\). \(\operatorname{cosec}\theta = \frac{1}{\sin\theta}\) aur \(\operatorname{cosec} 2\theta = \frac{1}{2\sin\theta\cos\theta}\).

Multiply karein
\[= \dfrac{\cos\theta}{\sin\theta} + \dfrac{1}{\sin\theta}\]
\[= \dfrac{1 + \cos\theta}{\sin\theta}\]
Kyun: Pehli term mein seedha \(\frac{\cos\theta}{\sin\theta}\). Doosri mein \(\cos\theta \times \frac{2}{2\sin\theta\cos\theta}\): 2 aur \(\cos\theta\) cancel, bacha \(\frac{1}{\sin\theta}\). Dono ka denominator ek, to jama.

Aadhe angle ke formulas lagayein
\[= \dfrac{2\cos^2\frac{\theta}{2}}{2\sin\frac{\theta}{2}\cos\frac{\theta}{2}}\]
\[= \dfrac{\cos\frac{\theta}{2}}{\sin\frac{\theta}{2}} = \cot\dfrac{\theta}{2}\]
Kyun: \(\cos\theta = 2\cos^2\frac{\theta}{2} - 1\) se \(1 + \cos\theta = 2\cos^2\frac{\theta}{2}\). Neeche \(\sin\theta\) ka double angle formula. \(2\cos\frac{\theta}{2}\) cancel ho gaya aur cos bata sin, yani cot bacha.
Dhyan dein: part (iii) mein \(1 - \cos\) tha jo \(2\sin^2\) banta hai; yahan \(1 + \cos\) hai jo \(2\cos^2\) banta hai. Yeh jora yaad rakhein.

blocks.explanation:
Yahan ek khoobsurat chaal hai: sin/cos mein likhne ke baad upar \(\cos(2\alpha - \alpha)\) ka formula ban jata hai.
Plan: common denominator, phir fundamental law \(\cos(a - b) = \cos a\cos b + \sin a\sin b\) ulta lagana.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: L.H.S. \(= 1 + \tan\alpha\tan 2\alpha\).
Humein prove karna hai: L.H.S. \(= \sec 2\alpha\).
Tareeqa: Sin aur cos mein likh kar \(\cos 2\alpha\cos\alpha + \sin 2\alpha\sin\alpha = \cos(2\alpha - \alpha)\) pehchanna. Double angle kholne ki zaroorat hi nahi padegi.

Common denominator banayein
\[\text{L.H.S.} = 1 + \dfrac{\sin\alpha\sin 2\alpha}{\cos\alpha\cos 2\alpha}\]
\[= \dfrac{\cos\alpha\cos 2\alpha + \sin\alpha\sin 2\alpha}{\cos\alpha\cos 2\alpha}\]
Kyun: \(\tan = \frac{\sin}{\cos}\) dono angles ke liye. 1 ko \(\frac{\cos\alpha\cos 2\alpha}{\cos\alpha\cos 2\alpha}\) likh kar jama kiya.

Fundamental law pehchanein
\[= \dfrac{\cos(2\alpha - \alpha)}{\cos\alpha\cos 2\alpha}\]
\[= \dfrac{\cos\alpha}{\cos\alpha\cos 2\alpha}\]
Kyun: Upar \(\cos a\cos b + \sin a\sin b\) ka pattern hai, jo \(\cos(a - b)\) hai (Section 10.1.1 ka fundamental law), \(a = 2\alpha\), \(b = \alpha\) ke saath. \(2\alpha - \alpha = \alpha\).
Dhyan dein: plus sign wale pattern ka matlab minus angle hai: \(\cos\cos + \sin\sin = \cos(a - b)\).

Cancel karein
\[= \dfrac{1}{\cos 2\alpha} = \sec 2\alpha\]
Kyun: \(\cos\alpha\) upar neeche cancel. \(\frac{1}{\cos 2\alpha}\) ko sec kehte hain.

blocks.explanation:
Neeche \(\cos 3\theta\) hai. Triple angle formula usay \(\cos\theta\) ki powers mein badal deta hai, aur phir \(\cos 2\theta\) nikal aata hai.
Plan: dikhana ke \(\cos\theta + \cos 3\theta = 2\cos\theta\cos 2\theta\), phir divide.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: L.H.S. \(= \frac{2\sin\theta\sin 2\theta}{\cos\theta + \cos 3\theta}\).
Humein prove karna hai: L.H.S. \(= \tan 2\theta\tan\theta\).
Tareeqa: \(\cos 3\theta = 4\cos^3\theta - 3\cos\theta\) (Section 10.6) aur \(2\cos^2\theta - 1 = \cos 2\theta\). (Exercise 10.4 mein sum-to-product formula se bhi yahi milta hai.)

Denominator simplify karein
\[\cos\theta + \cos 3\theta = \cos\theta + 4\cos^3\theta - 3\cos\theta\]
\[= 4\cos^3\theta - 2\cos\theta\]
\[= 2\cos\theta(2\cos^2\theta - 1)\]
\[= 2\cos\theta\cos 2\theta\]
Kyun: \(\cos 3\theta\) ki jagah triple angle formula rakha. \(\cos\theta - 3\cos\theta = -2\cos\theta\). Phir \(2\cos\theta\) common nikala, aur bracket \(2\cos^2\theta - 1\) bilkul \(\cos 2\theta\) hai.

Divide karein
\[\text{L.H.S.} = \dfrac{2\sin\theta\sin 2\theta}{2\cos\theta\cos 2\theta}\]
\[= \dfrac{\sin\theta}{\cos\theta} \cdot \dfrac{\sin 2\theta}{\cos 2\theta}\]
\[= \tan\theta\tan 2\theta\]
Kyun: 2 cancel. Phir har angle ka sin usi angle ke cos ke saath jor diya: \(\frac{\sin\theta}{\cos\theta} = \tan\theta\) aur \(\frac{\sin 2\theta}{\cos 2\theta} = \tan 2\theta\). Multiplication mein tarteeb se farq nahi parta, is liye yeh \(\tan 2\theta\tan\theta\) hi hai.

blocks.explanation:
Har fraction triple angle formula se bohat saaf ho jata hai, kyunke \(\sin 3\theta\) ki har term mein \(\sin\theta\) aur \(\cos 3\theta\) ki har term mein \(\cos\theta\) hai.
Plan: dono fractions alag simplify karna, phir minus.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: L.H.S. \(= \frac{\sin 3\theta}{\sin\theta} - \frac{\cos 3\theta}{\cos\theta}\).
Humein prove karna hai: L.H.S. \(= 2\).
Tareeqa: \(\sin 3\theta = 3\sin\theta - 4\sin^3\theta\) aur \(\cos 3\theta = 4\cos^3\theta - 3\cos\theta\).

Har fraction simplify karein
\[\dfrac{\sin 3\theta}{\sin\theta} = 3 - 4\sin^2\theta\]
\[\dfrac{\cos 3\theta}{\cos\theta} = 4\cos^2\theta - 3\]
Kyun: \(\frac{3\sin\theta - 4\sin^3\theta}{\sin\theta}\) mein har term ko \(\sin\theta\) se divide kiya; isi tarah cos wale ko \(\cos\theta\) se.

Minus karein
\[\text{L.H.S.} = 3 - 4\sin^2\theta - 4\cos^2\theta + 3\]
\[= 6 - 4(\sin^2\theta + \cos^2\theta)\]
\[= 6 - 4 = 2\]
Kyun: Doosre fraction ko minus karte waqt us ki dono terms ka sign badla: \(-(4\cos^2\theta - 3) = -4\cos^2\theta + 3\). Phir \(-4\) common nikala aur \(\sin^2 + \cos^2 = 1\).
Dhyan dein: bracket ke aage minus ho to andar ki har term ka sign badalta hai; \(+3\) ko \(-3\) likhna aam ghalti hai.

blocks.explanation:
Yeh part (ix) wale hi do fractions hain, lekin is dafa jama.
Plan: dono ko triple angle formulas se simplify karna, jama karna, phir \(\cos^2\theta - \sin^2\theta = \cos 2\theta\).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: L.H.S. \(= \frac{\cos 3\theta}{\cos\theta} + \frac{\sin 3\theta}{\sin\theta}\).
Humein prove karna hai: L.H.S. \(= 4\cos 2\theta\).
Tareeqa: \(\sin 3\theta\) aur \(\cos 3\theta\) ke triple angle formulas. Part (ix) se tulna karein: wahan minus tha to \(\sin^2 + \cos^2\) bana, yahan plus hai to \(\cos^2 - \sin^2\) banega.

Har fraction simplify karein
\[\dfrac{\cos 3\theta}{\cos\theta} = 4\cos^2\theta - 3\]
\[\dfrac{\sin 3\theta}{\sin\theta} = 3 - 4\sin^2\theta\]
Kyun: Har term ko \(\cos\theta\) ya \(\sin\theta\) se divide kiya, bilkul part (ix) ki tarah.

Jama karein
\[\text{L.H.S.} = 4\cos^2\theta - 3 + 3 - 4\sin^2\theta\]
\[= 4(\cos^2\theta - \sin^2\theta)\]
\[= 4\cos 2\theta\]
Kyun: \(-3\) aur \(+3\) cancel. 4 common nikala, aur \(\cos^2\theta - \sin^2\theta\) \(\cos 2\theta\) ki pehli shakal hai.

blocks.explanation:
Left side par aadhe angles (\(\frac{\theta}{2}\)) aur right side par poora angle \(\theta\).
Plan: chhoti likhai ke liye \(s = \sin\frac{\theta}{2}\), \(c = \cos\frac{\theta}{2}\); upar aur neeche alag alag simplify karna.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: L.H.S. \(= \frac{\tan\frac{\theta}{2} + \cot\frac{\theta}{2}}{\cot\frac{\theta}{2} - \tan\frac{\theta}{2}}\).
Humein prove karna hai: L.H.S. \(= \sec\theta\).
Tareeqa: \(s, c\) mein: \(\tan\frac{\theta}{2} = \frac{s}{c}\), \(\cot\frac{\theta}{2} = \frac{c}{s}\). Phir \(s^2 + c^2 = 1\) aur \(c^2 - s^2 = \cos\theta\) (double angle, angle \(\frac{\theta}{2}\)). Lambi expressions mein letters rakhne se ghaltiyan kam hoti hain.

Numerator simplify karein
\[\dfrac{s}{c} + \dfrac{c}{s} = \dfrac{s^2 + c^2}{sc} = \dfrac{1}{sc}\]
Kyun: Common denominator \(sc\). Upar \(\sin^2 + \cos^2\) ek hi angle ka hai, is liye 1.

Denominator simplify karein
\[\dfrac{c}{s} - \dfrac{s}{c} = \dfrac{c^2 - s^2}{sc} = \dfrac{\cos\theta}{sc}\]
Kyun: Wohi common denominator. Upar \(\cos^2\frac{\theta}{2} - \sin^2\frac{\theta}{2}\) hai, jo double angle formula se \(\cos\theta\) hai (kyunke \(2 \times \frac{\theta}{2} = \theta\)).

Divide karein
\[\text{L.H.S.} = \dfrac{1/(sc)}{\cos\theta/(sc)}\]
\[= \dfrac{1}{\cos\theta} = \sec\theta\]
Kyun: Upar neeche dono ka denominator \(sc\) hai; fraction ko fraction se divide karte waqt yeh cancel ho jata hai. \(\frac{1}{\cos\theta} = \sec\theta\).
Dhyan dein: tan aur cot ka jama \(\frac{1}{sc}\) hota hai, yeh chhota sa nateeja bohat se sawalon mein kaam aata hai.

blocks.explanation:
Yahan parts (ix)-(x) ki tarah \(\sin 3\theta\) ke neeche \(\sin\theta\) nahi, balke \(\cos\theta\) hai; denominators ulte hain. Is liye triple angle formula ki jagah common denominator behtar hai.
Plan: common denominator; upar \(\cos(3\theta - \theta)\) aur neeche \(\frac{1}{2}\sin 2\theta\) pehchanna.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: L.H.S. \(= \frac{\sin 3\theta}{\cos\theta} + \frac{\cos 3\theta}{\sin\theta}\).
Humein prove karna hai: L.H.S. \(= 2\cot 2\theta\).
Tareeqa: \(\cos 3\theta\cos\theta + \sin 3\theta\sin\theta = \cos(3\theta - \theta)\) (fundamental law) aur \(\sin\theta\cos\theta = \frac{1}{2}\sin 2\theta\).

Common denominator banayein
\[\text{L.H.S.} = \dfrac{\sin 3\theta\sin\theta + \cos 3\theta\cos\theta}{\sin\theta\cos\theta}\]
Kyun: Pehle fraction ko upar neeche \(\sin\theta\) se aur doosre ko \(\cos\theta\) se multiply kiya taake denominator \(\sin\theta\cos\theta\) ho jaye.

Fundamental law aur double angle lagayein
\[= \dfrac{\cos(3\theta - \theta)}{\tfrac{1}{2}\sin 2\theta}\]
\[= \dfrac{2\cos 2\theta}{\sin 2\theta} = 2\cot 2\theta\]
Kyun: Upar \(\cos a\cos b + \sin a\sin b\) ka pattern hai, \(a = 3\theta\), \(b = \theta\), jo \(\cos 2\theta\) deta hai. Neeche \(\sin\theta\cos\theta\) \(\sin 2\theta\) ka aadha hai; aadhe se divide yani 2 se multiply.
Dhyan dein: pehle triple angle formula lagane ki koshish karte to kaafi lamba hisaab banta; sahi raasta pehchanna waqt bachata hai.

blocks.explanation:
Is part mein dono sides ko ek hi cheez \(\sin^2 2\theta\) mein likh sakte hain. Jab ek side se doosri tak seedha raasta na dikhe to dono ko ek teesri shakal tak le jana bhi poora proof hai.
Plan: left side mein \(\cos 4\theta = 1 - 2\sin^2 2\theta\); right side mein \(\sin^4\theta + \cos^4\theta = 1 - \frac{1}{2}\sin^2 2\theta\).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: L.H.S. \(= \frac{3 + \cos 4\theta}{1 - \cos 4\theta}\).
Humein prove karna hai: L.H.S. \(= \frac{1}{2}\left(\tan^{2}\theta + \cot^{2}\theta\right)\).
Tareeqa: \(u = \sin^2 2\theta\) maan lein. Dikhana hai ke dono sides \(\frac{2 - u}{u}\) ke barabar hain. Letter \(u\) rakhne se lambi likhai bach jati hai.

Left side
\[\cos 4\theta = 1 - 2\sin^2 2\theta = 1 - 2u\]
\[\text{L.H.S.} = \dfrac{3 + 1 - 2u}{1 - 1 + 2u}\]
\[= \dfrac{4 - 2u}{2u} = \dfrac{2 - u}{u}\]
Kyun: \(\cos 2x = 1 - 2\sin^2 x\) mein \(x = 2\theta\) rakha, kyunke \(4\theta = 2(2\theta)\). Neeche \(1 - (1 - 2u) = 2u\). Phir upar neeche 2 cancel.

Right side: common denominator
\[\tan^2\theta + \cot^2\theta = \dfrac{\sin^4\theta + \cos^4\theta}{\sin^2\theta\cos^2\theta}\]
Kyun: \(\frac{\sin^2\theta}{\cos^2\theta} + \frac{\cos^2\theta}{\sin^2\theta}\) ka common denominator \(\sin^2\theta\cos^2\theta\); upar \(\sin^4 + \cos^4\).

Right side ko \(u\) mein likhein
\[\sin^4\theta + \cos^4\theta\]
\[= (\sin^2\theta + \cos^2\theta)^2\]
\[\quad - 2\sin^2\theta\cos^2\theta\]
\[= 1 - \tfrac{1}{2}u\]
\[\sin^2\theta\cos^2\theta = \tfrac{1}{4}u\]
Kyun: \(a^2 + b^2 = (a + b)^2 - 2ab\), jahan \(a = \sin^2\theta\), \(b = \cos^2\theta\); \(a + b = 1\). Aur \(\sin\theta\cos\theta = \frac{1}{2}\sin 2\theta\), is ka square \(\frac{1}{4}\sin^2 2\theta = \frac{1}{4}u\). Is liye \(2\sin^2\theta\cos^2\theta = \frac{1}{2}u\).

Right side mukammal karein
\[\text{R.H.S.} = \dfrac{1}{2} \cdot \dfrac{1 - \frac{1}{2}u}{\frac{1}{4}u}\]
\[= \dfrac{2(1 - \frac{1}{2}u)}{u} = \dfrac{2 - u}{u}\]
Kyun: \(\frac{1}{2}\) ko \(\frac{1}{4}\) se divide karna 2 deta hai. Dono sides \(\frac{2 - u}{u}\) ban gayin, is liye barabar hain.
Dhyan dein: \(\sin^4 + \cos^4\) ko 1 likh dena bohat aam ghalti hai; 1 sirf \(\sin^2 + \cos^2\) hota hai.

blocks.explanation:
\(1 + \sin 2\theta\) aur \(1 - \sin 2\theta\) dono poore squares hain, aur \(\frac{1 + \tan\theta}{1 - \tan\theta}\) asal mein \(\tan(\frac{\pi}{4} + \theta)\) hai.
Plan: poore squares banana, \(\cos\theta\) se divide kar ke tan laana, phir \(\tan(a + b)\) ka formula.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: L.H.S. \(= \frac{1 + \sin 2\theta}{1 - \sin 2\theta}\).
Humein prove karna hai: L.H.S. \(= \tan^{2}\left(\frac{\pi}{4} + \theta\right)\).
Tareeqa: \(1 \pm \sin 2\theta = (\cos\theta \pm \sin\theta)^2\) aur \(\tan(a + b) = \frac{\tan a + \tan b}{1 - \tan a\tan b}\), jahan \(\tan\frac{\pi}{4} = 1\). Is sawal mein teen alag ideas ek saath aate hain.

Poore squares banayein
\[1 + \sin 2\theta = (\cos\theta + \sin\theta)^2\]
\[1 - \sin 2\theta = (\cos\theta - \sin\theta)^2\]
Kyun: 1 ko \(\cos^2\theta + \sin^2\theta\) aur \(\sin 2\theta\) ko \(2\sin\theta\cos\theta\) likha; \(a^2 + b^2 \pm 2ab = (a \pm b)^2\). Yeh wohi chaal hai jo part (v) mein thi.

Upar neeche \(\cos\theta\) se divide karein
\[\text{L.H.S.} = \left(\dfrac{\cos\theta + \sin\theta}{\cos\theta - \sin\theta}\right)^2\]
\[= \left(\dfrac{1 + \tan\theta}{1 - \tan\theta}\right)^2\]
Kyun: Squares ka fraction, fraction ka square hai. Bracket ke andar har term ko \(\cos\theta\) se divide kiya: \(\frac{\cos\theta}{\cos\theta} = 1\), \(\frac{\sin\theta}{\cos\theta} = \tan\theta\). Is se value nahi badli.

\(\tan(\frac{\pi}{4} + \theta)\) pehchanein
\[\dfrac{1 + \tan\theta}{1 - \tan\theta} = \dfrac{\tan\frac{\pi}{4} + \tan\theta}{1 - \tan\frac{\pi}{4}\tan\theta}\]
\[= \tan\left(\tfrac{\pi}{4} + \theta\right)\]
\[\text{L.H.S.} = \tan^2\left(\tfrac{\pi}{4} + \theta\right)\]
Kyun: 1 ko \(\tan\frac{\pi}{4}\) likha (kyunke \(\tan 45^{\circ} = 1\)). Ab yeh bilkul \(\tan(a + b)\) ka formula hai, \(a = \frac{\pi}{4}\), \(b = \theta\). Square bahar tha, wohi rehta hai.
Dhyan dein: "1 ko \(\tan 45^{\circ}\) likhna" ek mashhoor chaal hai; jab bhi \(\frac{1 \pm \tan}{1 \mp \tan}\) dikhe to yahi socha karein.

blocks.explanation:
Chaar angles hain jo jore banate hain: \(\frac{7\pi}{8} = \pi - \frac{\pi}{8}\), \(\frac{5\pi}{8} = \pi - \frac{3\pi}{8}\), aur \(\frac{3\pi}{8} = \frac{\pi}{2} - \frac{\pi}{8}\). (\(\frac{\pi}{8} = 22.5^{\circ}\).)
Plan: sab ko \(\frac{\pi}{8}\) mein badalna, phir \(\sin^2 + \cos^2 = 1\). Kisi angle ki value nikalne ki zaroorat nahi.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: L.H.S. \(= \cos^{2}\frac{\pi}{8} + \cos^{2}\frac{3\pi}{8} + \cos^{2}\frac{5\pi}{8} + \cos^{2}\frac{7\pi}{8}\).
Humein prove karna hai: L.H.S. \(= 2\).
Tareeqa: Allied angles: \(\cos(\pi - x) = -\cos x\) (square se minus khatam) aur \(\cos(\frac{\pi}{2} - x) = \sin x\).

Aakhri do ko pehle do ke saath jorein
\[\cos^2\tfrac{7\pi}{8} = \cos^2\left(\pi - \tfrac{\pi}{8}\right) = \cos^2\tfrac{\pi}{8}\]
\[\cos^2\tfrac{5\pi}{8} = \cos^2\left(\pi - \tfrac{3\pi}{8}\right) = \cos^2\tfrac{3\pi}{8}\]
Kyun: \(\pi - x\) quadrant II mein hai jahan cos negative hai, magar square karne se minus khatam. Is liye \(\cos^2(\pi - x) = \cos^2 x\).

Ikattha karein
\[\text{L.H.S.} = 2\cos^2\tfrac{\pi}{8} + 2\cos^2\tfrac{3\pi}{8}\]
Kyun: Ab har square do dafa aa raha hai.

Co-ratio lagayein
\[\cos\tfrac{3\pi}{8} = \cos\left(\tfrac{\pi}{2} - \tfrac{\pi}{8}\right) = \sin\tfrac{\pi}{8}\]
\[\text{L.H.S.} = 2\left(\cos^2\tfrac{\pi}{8} + \sin^2\tfrac{\pi}{8}\right)\]
\[= 2(1) = 2\]
Kyun: \(\frac{\pi}{2}\) odd multiple hai, is liye cos badal kar sin; \(\frac{3\pi}{8}\) quadrant I mein hai, positive. Phir 2 common nikala aur ek hi angle ka \(\sin^2 + \cos^2 = 1\).
Dhyan dein: \(\cos^2\frac{\pi}{8}\) aur \(\sin^2\frac{\pi}{8}\) ki alag values nikalne ki koshish na karein; pehchan lena ke yeh 1 banate hain, yahi sawal ki jaan hai.
